offlineDraft.deviceDraftText:
Case Note

A visit was conducted on 12/11 with Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea present. Mould was observed in the back bedroom, with increased severity noted by the window.  The landlord has not responded to two sent emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline last week; a letter regarding this was found on the table. The date of birth listed on the form is 3/3/87. It was agreed that a call to the landlord will be made on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday, and Tomas Brandvold, a neighbour, has offered assistance with the form.  A risk of rent arrears is identified should the form remain late.  A follow-up visit is scheduled for 26/11.

finishedText:
Case Note Date: 12/11

Present at the visit were Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea. 

Maria Okonkwo-Reyes reported that mould in the back bedroom has returned and is worse by the window. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes stated that the landlord has not replied to two emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes also missed the benefits form deadline. A letter is on the table, and the date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. 

It was agreed that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes agreed that she will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on the worker's list, offered to help her with the form. 

The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late. 

The next step is to revisit on 26/11.
